summary: YPF S.A. filed a 6-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing that all conditions precedent were satisfied and it closed the acquisition of 24.99% of the share capital and voting rights of YPF Energía Eléctrica S.A. (YPF Luz), following an October 8, 2026 material event notice. The transaction lifts YPF's direct and indirect ownership of YPF Luz to 100%, consolidating the subsidiary fully. No price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation was stated in the excerpt. The filing is a post-closing notice to the CNV, ByMA, and A3 Mercados; consolidated financials and related-party note disclosure are referenced. Watch for purchase-price disclosure and minority buyout terms.
